==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I induced lucidity via sleep paralysis. A reality warping golem princess came to conquer the world. (This dream takes place in the same continuity of lucid dreams that started on 06/11/2025 and has continued to the present. These dreams take place in the Elven Village that resembles huts of wood and white stone, as well as castles, and is located in a forest of tall pine trees.) (The Golem Princess resembled a bald, golem woman with an hourglass figure. Her upper body was made of pink crystals, her lower body was made of yellow crystals, and she wore a long sparkling golden veil.)

When she grabbed me, I used my magic to become living acid and sliced through her. (I used the Solvo spell to melt into liquid like I did the night before, but this time I made myself less like water and more like acid.)

I kept a piece of her stone for its reality warping properties. (The Reality Warping Stone resembles a jagged diamond that is half pink and half yellow.)

(A fascinating note about this dream is that I initially could not beat the golem princess. I had to actually wake up, come up with a strategy, and then go back to sleep to win. Luckily I was able to very quickly fall into sleep paralysis and essentially restart the dream. In the initial iteration of this dream, I couldn't identify any of the golem princess' weaknesses and I was forced to flee into the desert.)
